questions.q: The newly appointed chief executive officer has been working under the assumption that the quarterly revenue targets could be achieved without downsizing the operations department.

questions.q: The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness, "Can you state with absolute certainty that you observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight?"

The lead defense attorney asked the prime witness if he could state with absolute certainty that he had observed the suspect leaving the residential complex before midnight.

questions.e: The reporting verb “asked” is in the past, so “can” changes to “could”. The observation occurred earlier, so “had observed” appropriately represents that earlier action. An indirect question takes “if/whether”, not “that whether”.
questions.eh: “Asked” past में है, इसलिए “can” सामान्यतः “could” होता है। Observation पहले हुई थी, इसलिए “had observed” उपयुक्त है। Indirect question में “if/whether” आता है, “that whether” नहीं.

questions.q: In an era dominated by rapid globalization, maintaining an insular approach to foreign policy can severely alienate a developing country from its global allies.
questions.e: “Insular” means narrow-minded or limited to one’s own group, culture, or ideas. “Cosmopolitan” means familiar with and open to different cultures and ideas, so it is the antonym.
questions.eh: “Insular” का अर्थ संकीर्ण सोच वाला या अपने ही समूह/संस्कृति/विचारों तक सीमित होना है। “Cosmopolitan” विभिन्न संस्कृतियों और विचारों के प्रति परिचित एवं उदार होने को दर्शाता है, इसलिए यह antonym है.
questions.instruction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the word “insular”.

explanation.why_correct: “Insular” means narrow-minded or limited to one’s own group, culture, or ideas. “Cosmopolitan” means familiar with and open to different cultures and ideas, so it is the antonym.
explanation.hindi_explanation: “Insular” का अर्थ संकीर्ण सोच वाला या अपने ही समूह/संस्कृति/विचारों तक सीमित होना है। “Cosmopolitan” विभिन्न संस्कृतियों और विचारों के प्रति परिचित एवं उदार होने को दर्शाता है, इसलिए यह antonym है.

option_explanations.A: Parochial = narrow or limited in outlook. Hindi: संकीर्ण या सीमित दृष्टिकोण वाला.
option_explanations.B: Cosmopolitan = familiar with and open to many different cultures and places. Hindi: विभिन्न संस्कृतियों से परिचित और उदार.
option_explanations.C: Detached = separate, disconnected, or emotionally uninvolved. Hindi: अलग, असंबद्ध या भावनात्मक रूप से दूर.
option_explanations.D: Prejudiced = having preconceived and often unfair opinions. Hindi: पूर्वाग्रह से ग्रस्त.

target_vocabulary.meaning: Narrow-minded; uninterested in ideas, cultures, or people outside one’s own experience.

questions.q:
P: While green energy sources like solar and wind power offer a sustainable alternative, their intermittent nature presents a significant operational hurdle for heavy industries.
Q: To resolve this grid instability, engineering firms are investing heavily in advanced lithium-ion battery storage infrastructure.
R: The global transition toward a carbon-neutral economy requires an immediate and massive overhaul of existing power grids.
S: Without these robust storage systems, manufacturing plants risk frequent operational blackouts during seasonal weather changes.
questions.e: R introduces the broad issue of the power-grid overhaul. P identifies the intermittency problem. Q presents battery storage as the solution, and S gives the consequence of lacking that storage. Therefore, the sequence is RPQS.
questions.eh: R power-grid overhaul का व्यापक विषय देता है। P intermittency की समस्या बताता है। Q battery storage का solution देता है और S storage न होने का परिणाम बताता है। इसलिए क्रम RPQS है.
questions.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the most logical sequence.

explanation.why_correct: R introduces the broad issue of the power-grid overhaul. P identifies the intermittency problem. Q presents battery storage as the solution, and S gives the consequence of lacking that storage. Therefore, the sequence is RPQS.
explanation.hindi_explanation: R power-grid overhaul का व्यापक विषय देता है। P intermittency की समस्या बताता है। Q battery storage का solution देता है और S storage न होने का परिणाम बताता है। इसलिए क्रम RPQS है.

questions.q: During the corporate crisis, the junior executives were told to keep their chin up as the management was actively working to secure an external bailout package.
o: To remain cheerful and optimistic in difficult circumstances
To stay vigilant against internal corporate espionage
To voice their complaints aggressively to the board
questions.e: “Keep your chin up” means to remain brave, hopeful, and optimistic during a difficult situation.
questions.eh: “Keep your chin up” का अर्थ कठिन परिस्थिति में हिम्मत, उम्मीद और सकारात्मकता बनाए रखना है.
questions.instruction: Choose the option that gives the correct meaning of the idiom “keep your chin up”.

explanation.why_correct: “Keep your chin up” means to remain brave, hopeful, and optimistic during a difficult situation.
explanation.hindi_explanation: “Keep your chin up” का अर्थ कठिन परिस्थिति में हिम्मत, उम्मीद और सकारात्मकता बनाए रखना है.

option_explanations.A: Remain arrogant and unyielding = stay proud and unwilling to change. Hindi: घमंडी और अड़ियल बने रहना.
option_explanations.B: Remain cheerful and optimistic in difficulty = stay hopeful and positive. Hindi: कठिनाई में भी खुश और आशावादी रहना.
option_explanations.C: Stay vigilant against internal corporate espionage = remain alert to spying within the organization. Hindi: संगठन के भीतर जासूसी के प्रति सतर्क रहना.
option_explanations.D: Voice complaints aggressively to the board = express grievances forcefully to senior management. Hindi: बोर्ड के सामने शिकायतें आक्रामक ढंग से रखना.

questions.q: The architectural firm meticulously designed the futuristic blueprint of the smart city to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
o: The futuristic blueprint of the smart city was being meticulously designed by the architectural firm to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.
The futuristic blueprint of the smart city was meticulously designed by the architectural firm to ensure optimal utilization of renewable energy resources.

questions.e: The active sentence is in the Simple Past (“designed”). Its passive form is “was/were + past participle”, giving “was meticulously designed”.
questions.eh: “Designed” Simple Past है, इसलिए passive में “was/were + V3” आएगा। सही रूप “was meticulously designed” है.

questions.q: The project coordinator said to the team members, "Do not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays next month."
o: The project coordinator warned the team members not to compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase would face severe delays the following month.
The project coordinator told the team members to not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays next month.
The project coordinator ordered the team members that they should not compromise on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase would face severe delays next month.
The project coordinator warned the team members against compromising on the software quality checks, otherwise the deployment phase will face severe delays the following month.
questions.e: A negative imperative can be reported with “warned/told + object + not to”. Because the reporting verb is in the past, “will” becomes “would”, and “next month” becomes “the following month”.
questions.eh: Negative imperative को “warned/told + object + not to” से report किया जा सकता है। Past reporting के कारण “will” → “would” और “next month” → “the following month” होता है.
